_about: Every part of the Leaf that holds code or a code-like configuration. The source for zero_cpu.py and boot_budget.py. Sizes are [HYPOTHESIS] until the supplier data sheets arrive.

chips.name: secure element
chips.core: secure microcontroller core inside a certified secure element
chips.code: vendor ROM boot loader; native Budlum-specified firmware; no Java Card VM, no applet loader
chips.fail_policy: slot B of U7; both bad: SE_FAULT screen, wallet locked, no session
conditions: supplier ships native firmware without a Java Card VM or a GlobalPlatform applet loader

chips.name: power and dead-pad chip
chips.core: power-management sequencer with a small patch core
chips.code: mask ROM defaults; OTP trim; a 32 KiB signed patch
chips.gate: U7 holds the patch-enable bit; the ROM defaults run until it is set
chips.fail_policy: ROM defaults: safe rails, charge limited to the ROM current, pads dead until auth
conditions: the ROM defaults alone power U7, U1 ROM and the dead-pad handshake

chips.name: TCON and local compositor
jobs: compositor: cursor, scroll, glyph echo, warp
touch scan at 480 Hz [HYPOTHESIS: touch front end inside U1]
chips.core: fixed-function pipeline with a timing microsequencer
chips.code: safe-screen mask ROM (not updatable); 256 KiB of timing and warp microcode
chips.gate: the microcode path stays off until U7 passes it; the ROM path needs no gate
chips.fail_policy: ROM mode: the safe screen and the stated lines only, no compositor
conditions: the safe-screen ROM path is a separate hardware path that runs with no microcode

chips.name: slice decoder and frame store
chips.core: decoder control core inside a hardware codec
chips.gate: U4 holds the U6 to U1 pixel lane open-circuit until U7 passes U6
chips.fail_policy: slot B; both bad: no stream, RECOVERY screen; the repair download still runs through U7
conditions: supplier gives a ROM-derived attestation key (DICE) or an owner-key secure boot

chips.name: Wi-Fi 7 and BT 6.0 combo
jobs: association and keys of the access network
chips.core: radio control cores of a hostless combo part
chips.gate: U4 holds the PA rail and the data lane until U7 passes U2A
chips.fail_policy: slot B; both bad: quarantine, the 5G path serves, the repair download uses U5
conditions: a hostless variant that boots from its own flash with no host driver
interfaces: the transport layer (UDP, path switch) location is agreed with the link team

chips.name: 60 GHz and UWB
jobs: UWB secure ranging with the scrambled timestamp sequence
chips.gate: U4 holds the PA rail and the data lane until U7 passes U2B
chips.fail_policy: quarantine; the L0 distance proof is off and the session states it (SW-24)

chips.name: 5G standalone modem
chips.core: baseband DSP cores and protocol control cores inside the modem
chips.code: 48 MiB of modem firmware in the in-package NAND
chips.internal_scheduler: vendor real-time scheduler inside the modem
chips.gate: U4 holds the RF front-end rail and the data lane until U7 passes U5
chips.fail_policy: slot B; both bad: quarantine, Wi-Fi serves; the modem stays attached in standby, never cold boots on a wake
conditions: owner-key secure boot with a Budlum key hash in the modem OTP
a signed measurement report to U7
SIM toolkit proactive commands disabled in the modem firmware

chips.name: eSIM (eUICC) inside U5
jobs: network credentials of the operator profile
chips.core: smart-card core under GSMA SGP rules
chips.code: card OS from the eUICC vendor; operator profiles from the operator
chips.gate: U5 is its only link; the modem firmware drops proactive commands
conditions: profiles with SIM toolkit applets are refused by the modem firmware
open: a profile can carry operator applets that run inside the card. Ayaz rules whether a sealed credential card is inside the rule.

chips.name: audio codec
chips.core: audio DSP core with fixed filters
chips.code: 128 KiB of codec and masking firmware
chips.gate: U4 holds the microphone bias and the codec rail until U7 passes U3
chips.fail_policy: quarantine: audio muted, microphones unpowered, the session states it
conditions: the DSP program RAM is write-locked after boot

chips.name: IMU
chips.core: sensor with a fixed state-machine engine
chips.gate: U7 loads the configuration itself after the hash check
chips.fail_policy: quarantine: tuner uses the default seat, the session states it
conditions: the configuration registers lock after the load

chips.name: 50 MP sensor and raw path
chips.gate: U4 holds the sensor rail; the hardware light shares the rail (R4)
chips.fail_policy: quarantine: camera off, light off, the session states it
interfaces: the ISP and encoder location of 21.5.1 is not yet placed in a part

chips.name: rear round AMOLED driver
chips.fail_policy: the face carries the safe screen

chips.name: quadrant node (x4)
chips.core: Qi receiver controller core; the authenticator is fixed-function
chips.code: 64 KiB of Qi receiver firmware per quadrant
chips.gate: the dead-pad FET: the quadrant stays at 0 V until the handshake carries a passing measurement
chips.fail_policy: that quadrant stays dead; the others serve; the face states it
conditions: the authenticator reports the hash of the Qi firmware and the LUT inside the 3 ms answer

chips.name: port part U_PD
chips.gate: the dead-pad law of the 12 pads
chips.fail_policy: the pads stay dead; the face states it (R5)
conditions: the port part has its own product manifest, port-1
